narutoloading.screen.subtitle: Loading-screen video and world walls
narutoloading.media.title: Media
narutoloading.media.subtitle: The library shared by the loading screen and the world walls
narutoloading.media.pick.desc: Restarts playback with the new entry
narutoloading.media.import.title: Import media
narutoloading.media.import.failed: The selected file could not be copied; see the log
narutoloading.media.import.unplayable: Copied %s, but it cannot be read yet; check FFmpeg under General
narutoloading.media.note.desc: The player stops once a world is loaded; the selection is kept for the next loading screen.
narutoloading.media.folder.desc: A relative path is resolved against the game directory
narutoloading.media.folder.note.desc: naruto.mp4 and naruto.m4a form one entry with picture and sound; a video alone plays muted.
narutoloading.media.folder.formats.desc: Video: mp4, mkv, webm, mov, m4v, avi, flv. Audio: ogg, opus, mp3, flac, wav, m4a, aac.
narutoloading.media.mode.desc: How the next entry is picked before each loading screen
narutoloading.media.fixedName.desc: Falls back to random when the name is missing
narutoloading.download.title: Add media from a link
narutoloading.download.summary.ready: Download into the media folder with yt-dlp
narutoloading.download.missing.desc: Download yt-dlp.exe from the official release page; there is no installer. The chosen file is copied into the game folder.
narutoloading.download.link.desc: A single video page; playlists are ignored
narutoloading.download.name: File name
narutoloading.download.name.hint: e.g. Naruto Mobile Tenth Anniversary Login CG
narutoloading.download.note.desc: The video is saved as <name>.<ext> and the audio as <name>.audio.<ext>; they are paired into one entry when the download finishes.
narutoloading.download.install.failed: Could not copy the file; see the log
narutoloading.download.unplayable: Saved as %s, but it cannot be read yet; check FFmpeg under General
narutoloading.loading.title: Loading screen
narutoloading.loading.subtitle: Replaces the screens shown before a world loads
narutoloading.loading.width.desc: Wider videos are scaled down, keeping the aspect ratio
narutoloading.loading.height.desc: Taller videos are scaled down, keeping the aspect ratio
narutoloading.loading.mute: Mute vanilla music while the video has sound
narutoloading.loading.mute.desc: Only applies when the video carries an audio track
narutoloading.loading.fade: Fade out UI while the mouse is still
narutoloading.loading.fade.desc: Only affects the loading screen's buttons, logo and text; any input brings them back
narutoloading.loading.fade.note.desc: Changes are saved immediately and apply on the next loading screen.
narutoloading.walls.title: World walls
narutoloading.walls.subtitle: Play video on block frames
narutoloading.walls.target.desc: Walls in this dimension, nearest first; the wall under the crosshair is selected by default
narutoloading.walls.empty.desc: Hold a stick, sneak and right-click two opposite corner blocks of the frame to build one.
narutoloading.walls.unavailable: No wall to manage right now
narutoloading.walls.unavailable.desc: Join a world whose server runs NarutoLoading and nearby walls will be listed here.
narutoloading.walls.build.desc: Hold the builder item (a stick by default), sneak and right-click one corner of the frame, then the opposite corner. Allowed frame blocks and size limits live in the server's config/narutoloading-server.properties.
narutoloading.walls.media.desc: The entry this wall plays; every player needs the same file locally
narutoloading.walls.volume.desc: Multiplied on top of the global gain and distance falloff
narutoloading.walls.light.desc: Lights up nearby blocks with the video's brightness
narutoloading.walls.light.unavailable.de: Another mod already controls block light emission (BlockState#getLightEmission), so this switch cannot take effect.
narutoloading.walls.clean.title: Clear the blocks inside?
narutoloading.walls.clean.message: Every block inside the frame except the border itself is destroyed.
narutoloading.walls.remove.title: Delete this wall?
narutoloading.walls.remove.message: Only the wall definition is deleted; the frame blocks stay.
narutoloading.walls.width.desc: Wider walls are scaled down, keeping the aspect ratio
narutoloading.walls.height.desc: Taller walls are scaled down, keeping the aspect ratio
narutoloading.walls.cullFaces.desc: Hides the block faces behind the video
narutoloading.walls.lightEnabled.desc: Turning this off stops every wall from lighting its surroundings
narutoloading.walls.maxActive.desc: Caps how many walls work when several are nearby
narutoloading.walls.cull.desc: Pauses after four seconds out of view until the wall is seen again
narutoloading.walls.audioEnabled.desc: Only the nearest walls are audible
narutoloading.walls.audioVolume.desc: Multiplied on top of the master volume and distance falloff
narutoloading.walls.maxAudio.desc: The nearest walls within the audio distance
narutoloading.wall.title: Wall #%s
narutoloading.wall.media.desc: Only the name is synced; every player needs the same file locally
narutoloading.wall.media.note.desc: Changes are saved to the server once you stop interacting; there is no save button.
narutoloading.wall.volume.desc: Multiplied on top of the global gain and distance falloff
narutoloading.wall.light.desc: Lights up nearby blocks with the video's brightness
narutoloading.wall.light.unavailable.des: Another mod already controls block light emission (BlockState#getLightEmission), so this switch cannot take effect.
narutoloading.wall.clean.title: Clear the blocks inside?
narutoloading.wall.clean.message: Every block inside the frame except the border itself is destroyed.
narutoloading.wall.remove.title: Delete this wall?
narutoloading.wall.remove.message: Only the wall definition is deleted; the frame blocks stay.
narutoloading.general.title: General
narutoloading.general.subtitle: Appearance, external tools and advanced options
narutoloading.general.theme.desc: Colors for the shell, cards and shimmer; previewed and saved immediately
narutoloading.general.shimmer.desc: A moving highlight runs across titles, cards and control labels
narutoloading.general.shimmerStrength.de: How much the highlight blends the base color away
narutoloading.general.shimmerFps.desc: Updates per second; lower costs less
narutoloading.general.ffmpeg.hint.desc: ffmpeg decodes the picture and ffprobe reads duration and resolution; put both files from the same build into one folder.
narutoloading.general.ytdlp.hint.desc: Download the single yt-dlp.exe from the official release page; choosing it copies the file into the game folder.
narutoloading.general.ytdlp.installFaile: Could not copy the file; see the log
narutoloading.general.debug.desc: Prints the frame decoding cost to the log
narutoloading.general.reset.title: Restore defaults?
narutoloading.general.reset.message: Every setting returns to its initial value, including the theme, media folder and wall options.
narutoloading.general.shortcuts.desc: Press Ctrl+V while no text field is focused to open this screen with the clipboard link; Config in the mod list opens it too.
narutoloading.general.faq.ffmpeg.desc: Check that ffmpeg and ffprobe are in the same folder, then press "Find again" above.
narutoloading.general.faq.black.desc: Both the loading screen and the world walls always render through YUV; if a picture stays black, check FFmpeg and the GPU driver, then look for a shader compile error in the log.
narutoloading.general.faq.wall: Other players cannot see a wall
narutoloading.general.faq.wall.desc: Only the media name is synced; every player must put a file with that name into their own media folder.
narutoloading.status.saveFailed: Could not save; see the log
narutoloading.message.wall.invalid: That is not a valid wall frame, or it exceeds the size limit.
